[abbhokāsika + aṅga 2 ], the practice or system of such ascetics or bhikkhu s (one of the dhutaṅga s) ; Mil 359, 21 ; Vism 75, 8 foll. (~aṃ pi channaṃ ca rukkhamūlaṃ ca paṭipakkhipāmi, ~aṃ samādiyāmī ti imesaṃ aññataravacanena samādinnaṃ hoti); — see also abbhokāsi(n).

abbhokāsī.p: [Abbhokāsa+ī] (ti) CL=9 A person who has the habit of living in a barren plain/ open air. A person practising Abbhokāsikadhutaṅga. See also Abbhokāsikaṅgasamādāna
